attr.title: Moonlight Embedded
attr.desc: Stream games from a PC running Sunshine, with a gamepad launcher (Settings / Play / Connect) for pairing, the PC address, stream settings and app selection. Streams at the device's native resolution by default, including 960x720 (4:3) and 720x720 panels.
attr.inst: Install Sunshine on the PC. Launch, set the PC's IP in Connect > IP Address if it isn't found, then Connect > Pair and enter the on-screen PIN in Sunshine's web UI.
